scripts.dev: npm run prepare:assets && node scripts/astro.mjs dev --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && node scripts/astro.mjs build
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests validation *.mjs *.json README.md IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md PRAYER_TIMES_VALIDATION.md LOCAL_TIMETABLE_REVIEW.md SERMON_CONTENT.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests validation *.mjs *.json README.md IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md PRAYER_TIMES_VALIDATION.md LOCAL_TIMETABLE_REVIEW.md SERMON_CONTENT.md
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run validate && npm run format:check
